Let me check the current state and then click on the remaining green blocks.

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
green_centers = []
for g in green:
    center_row = sum([p[0] for p in g['boundary']]) / len(g['boundary'])
    center_col = sum([p[1] for p in g['boundary']]) / len(g['boundary'])
    green_centers.append((center_row, center_col))
green_centers.sort()
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green)}")
print(f"Centers: {green_centers}")
# Target: click all except (33, 21)
targets = [c for c in green_centers if c != (33.0, 21.0)]
print(f"Targets to click: {targets}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
